chapter: A musical family and the old New Orleans bands
title: Cousin Big Belly Five-Ball, the comic trombonist
summary: Danny remembers his relative Tapo, nicknamed Big Belly Five-Ball, who played trombone comically.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: And I had a cousin, Big Belly Five-Ball. He played trombone. That's the Tapo branch of the family. He was famous for...

Tapo [SPELLS] His name was... I can't think of his last name, but... Yeah, it's Tapo. Yeah, that's right. Tapo. He played trombone, and he did it in a comic manner. He was big and fat. And his nickname was Big Belly Five-Ball. And he worked in the bands around. So you saw him.
